text.line: We have estimated the impact on costs and clients and will monitor this.
We will monitor management information on the number of cases passported and passing or failing means tests.
We will assess this by different case types, to investigate any emerging trends which may need action.
We will also inspect information on appeals and complaints.
Although we do not expect any disproportionate impact on protected groups, we will assess this to ensure that is the case.
We will monitor data where it is collected, although recognise that current collections are limited.
In terms of our continuing duty, we have included some equalities questions in the consultation and will consider any responses and update this statement as necessary in due course.
